speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The account is written out. I am not threading a needle until that is true, and it is true. Master Heminges has said it will be paid before Twelfth Night. He is not in this room. I do not need him in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Before Twelfth Night. I heard you. Ask what you came to ask.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: I will name a copy by the mark on it, not by the man who is surest. If two of you are sure, one of you is holding last month.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The songs, when the paper is done. I am counting the boys' songs. I am not improving them this morning.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The fastening is at the back. I can reach it.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: You have been pretending you can. Hold still, Master Latchet. Pretending is a way to tear a hook.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I felt it go in. I could not have got it myself.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: No. And I am not making a speech about a hook.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The chest is tight. I was not going to say so.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: It is let out. A seam, at the chest. I have done it. I am not discussing it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will not discuss it. It is easier, and the note is the note I came in on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same note. Lower, if a room asks for lower. Thou art not to test a height this morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not testing it. I came in under, as you said yesterday, and I am still under.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under is the rule. I have not cancelled a morning because a yard was kind, and I am not cancelling a song because a seam is kinder.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Two rolls with last month's mark. They are not current. I am not asking which of you is fond of them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Burn them.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Two. In the brazier. A man may insist his was the right one. He may insist at the ash.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: What I counted is on the current copies. I will not teach a song off a roll that is going into the fire.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is the coat current? The hook was not.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The coat is current. The hook was pride. Pride is mended. The account remains the thing I wrote before I threaded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ask the next. I will answer it now, and I will not make you a new one.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The page's second entrance. The mark is in the left margin. Who speaks it, and from where?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sam. From the left. I am not changing it to be kind to a hook.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Left. I can hold left, if the stair does not tell me a better story on the way up.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: There is no better story. Nick, the last of yours is the quiet one. I counted it. Do not decorate it for a finer room.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The quiet one. I have it under the note. I am not decorating a court that has not sat down yet.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I have no more cloth to argue. The account goes to Master Heminges as it was written. I am going while the light is still on the thread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the questions are the ones we had. The afternoon is another play. I am in it. That is all I am saying of the part.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Two rolls, ash. The current marks, kept. I have nothing further that a loud voice can improve.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And the mornings stand. Court is not a reason to sing higher. Eat before you decide you are nervous.
